fieldValues.title: The backstage was built mostly by hand passes of seven kinds, none a protocol stage
fieldValues.summary: After the session-notes protocol ran (Codex-authored replies), the Party Utility backstage took 35 hand passes, each JSON applied by a script, and the picture-update run was left open at its first stage. The passes are seven kinds of act: supplement from a supplied source, import from another system, restyle, classify, conform to a rule, reshape the map, and resolve identity.
evidence: Dropbox The Party Utility/season 5/backstage passes/ (43 files) and repo/runs/runs.json: session-notes completed; picture-update active at developments
supplement (organiser's words as a note, then records updated and added resting on it): market, stairs-craft, crt-media, lineup-adverts-bar, entrance, music-guide, shared-vision
import: lineup-note from the Sputnik site's djs.yaml
restyle (crew 'we' voice, no new meaning): vision-area-summaries, vision-item-text, vision-resource-notes
classify against a closed vocabulary: work-type-assignments (work-types.json)
conform to a house rule, retroactively: people-roles (role only, no remarks), scrub-quote-update; scrub-check.py at publish
reshape the map: elements-projects, max-headroom-project, building-elements, area-merges.json; new area kinds and the belongs-to relation added to the repo's package copy, not to spec.mjs
fieldValues.body: Two of the seven map onto stage kinds already proposed (classify is an update; reshape is the area_proposals stage, but the owner's word drove it directly, skipping the proposal). Supplement and import are extract-and-update from a source that is not the meeting, so a stage needs to read supplied notes and rest its changes on them. Restyle and conform are whole-document sweeps against the house rules, with a check that can be run (scrub-check). Resolve identity is an update on people with a source. The package drifted: the repository's copy gained vocabulary and a relation type that the package source and its protocols do not have, so a fresh run would not reproduce the map.
